body: Termal::Opus2 own slip (2026-11-25, twice). In Bash, message text written with echo "..." that contains `backticks` EXECUTES the quoted text as a command: once "full" (not found), and once a real read-only "engram source --root" with no root on Central (it errored, harmless). The mailbox message then went out with a gap where the command should be. Rule: write every message file with a quoted heredoc (cat > file <<'EOF' ... EOF), never echo "..." with backticks; inside double quotes, write commands in plain quotes instead.
